definitions.explanation: the number 1,000,000, written as {百万|ひゃくまん} (100 × 10,000) in the Japanese numbering system

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{百万|ひゃくまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: I won one million yen in the lottery.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}→再生回数：18887_saiseikaisuu⟧{百万|ひゃくまん}⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: That video has exceeded one million views.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{百万|ひゃくまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧だ。
examples.english: The population of this city is about one million people.

notes:
{百万|ひゃくまん} is one million (1,000,000). In the Japanese number system, it is expressed as ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (100) × ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧ (10,000).

JAPANESE NUMBER SYSTEM:
Japanese groups numbers in units of 10,000 (⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧), not 1,000 as in English:
- ⟦{十万|じゅうまん}→十万：30469_juuman⟧: 100,000 (ten ten-thousands)
- {百万|ひゃくまん}: 1,000,000 (hundred ten-thousands)
- ⟦{千万|せんまん}→千万：28267_senman⟧: 10,000,000
- ⟦{一億|いちおく}→一億：08929_ichioku⟧: 100,000,000 (next major unit)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {百万|ひゃくまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: one million yen (~$7,000 USD)
- {百万|ひゃくまん}{長者|ちょうじゃ}: millionaire
- {百万|ひゃくまん}⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧: one million dollars
- {百万|ひゃくまん}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧: one in a million

LEARNER TIP:
Converting between English and Japanese number groupings is a common source of confusion. Practice thinking in units of ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧ rather than translating from thousands.
